component.name: VisualLLM
component.summary: Visual fallback router for LLM endpoints

description.p: VisualLLM is a Linux-first Tauri desktop app for designing LLM fallback lanes by hand.
A user adds providers, browses catalogs, selects models into a pool, then drags models into ordered lanes. Each lane becomes a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
The model on the right answers first; everything to its left is a fallback. In data terms, members[0] is always the primary. The display order is the inverse of storage order.

Post-review hardening batch: status bar reads the engine ledger, per-lane notification mutes, auto-park budget tuning, one-click re-apply of the gateway token to editor integrations, and polling that pauses while the window is hidden.
Rolling per-lane request and failure counters, auto-parking of lanes that keep failing transiently, incident replay, and checked error handling.
